headline: Backup Report for Smith County Homes
summary: Smith County has a high outlook. It sees a long outage of 12 hours or more about once every 4 years. This comes from 8 years of records since 2018. In one big storm 56% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth waited about 57 hours. Homes with electric heat in Smith County get about 15 hours on one Core in January and about 31 hours on one Core in November. Two Cores last about 30 hours on one Core in January. The suggested number of Cores is 2 Cores. This covers 79% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
